landing.lede: A content management system. Editors compose pages from blocks, publishing writes a version, and each site renders the version that is live.
landing.contentBody: Pages are composed of blocks. Each block declares its own settings schema, and the editing form is generated from that schema.
landing.versioningBody: A draft, a stash and a published version are separate records. Publishing writes a snapshot; the one it replaces stays readable.
landing.themesBody: A theme supplies the blocks, page templates, typography and translations a site renders with. A site names one theme.
landing.sitesBody: Sites are grouped into programs and resolved by hostname. One installation serves all of them.
